title: Change Saga code references
description: One evidence record: the code a narrative target explains, pinned at commits. A diff is never stored; coverage is computed per comparison from these references.

commit.description: Full Git object name the reference is pinned at.

path.description: Normalized repository-relative slash path at that commit.

start.description: First referenced line, 1-based. Absent for a whole file.

end.description: Last referenced line, inclusive. Absent for a whole file.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the referenced bytes: the lines start..end including their newlines, or the whole file.
